verdict.rationale: PayPal documents narrow, built-in event-driven automations of its own: merchants can configure automatic invoice payment reminders, and subscriptions can automate payment recovery for failed payments. There is no general user-defined rules engine. Webhooks only notify the merchant's server, so they are a developer building block and earn no credit here. missing for 10: a general configurable rule/trigger-action builder, user-defined conditions across event types, documentation of rule configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate payment recovery for failed payments.
